Summary: The Employment Situation for October 2026 is scheduled to be published on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. (ET). The BLS publishes 12 Employment Situation reports each year, almost always on the first Friday of the month at 8:30am Eastern Time. The official schedule is maintained on the BLS release calendar. The Employment Situation for September 2026 was released on Friday, October 2, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. (ET).
